assay: rRNA-depleted total RNA-seq ('lncRNA sequencing') of whole mouse heart, Illumina HiSeq 2000; transcript-level quantification (HISAT2 + StringTie)
sample_inclusion: 3 EHP hearts (swimming 3 weeks + sedentary 1 week) and 3 sedentary hearts, male C57BL/6, collected 1 week after termination of swimming, before TAC/sham (S2.3.p1; GEO extract_protocol)
primary_estimand: Effect of exercise hypertrophic preconditioning (21 days swimming then 1 week detraining) vs sedentary on cardiac transcript (lncRNA) expression
planned_contrasts: EHP vs Sed (S2.3.p1, FIG4; paper: 2162 DE lncRNAs, 1482 up / 680 down)
paper_method: DESeq2 (FIG4 legend 'DESeq analysis'; GEO data_processing 'DEseq2'), ~ grp
